description: rmapi push failed with 'failed to parse .rmapi' error. Knox reported the failure and surfaced manual instructions but did not attempt the known fix: removing the corrupt .rmapi file, which forces rmapi to re-authenticate cleanly.
correction: When rmapi returns 'failed to parse .rmapi' (or any config parse error), delete ~/.rmapi and re-run rmapi. The tool will prompt for a new one-time code from my.remarkable.com. The corrupt file is the cause — removal forces a clean re-auth.
systemic_fix: Add rmapi error recovery protocol to chase-call-prep SKILL.md reMarkable Delivery section: if rmapi fails with a config parse error, delete ~/.rmapi before retrying.
